notes.title: Getting ready for Susan’s sex scene, your opinion about wrinkles and answering a few more questions
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/125053806_16-08-2024-10-24-08-292_capa-steam.jpg[/img]
Hello, my dear FreshMen!

We’re getting ready for a big sex scene, and I want to share a bit of our process with you!

This time, we’ll be dealing with an absolute fan favorite, and a character fans have been begging to have a spicy scene with since Episode 1: Susan! Your favorite MILF will have a VERY hot scene in Season 2!

I’m personally very, very excited about this scene. Susan hits all the marks for me: great body, beautiful face and a sexy personality. Here’s our plan: a scene full of teasing, 30+ animation in 60 FPS, sex sounds, moaning, and light BDSM in a Mommy Dom/Brat Switch setting (if you know, you know ;) ). What do you say? What’s something you’d like to do to Susan? Please let us know in the comments!

In other news, last week, our team developed a new wrinkles tech! Now, our character's skin will wrinkle and fold according to their facial expressions (and age). Before we commit to this fully, I’d like to hear your thoughts about it. A few members of our team are very excited about this, while others are afraid that this can make some characters look older. I think we can reach a nice balance by taking age into consideration when we calculate how strong this effect will be. What do you think about it?

Watch our tech demo here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TR6eWJwlDgo

Changing the subject a bit, I noticed a few common questions in my last post, so I thought we could take a moment to answer them here:

[h1] Wasn’t Season 2 supposed to be released in 2023? Why is it taking so long? [/h1]

Yes, Season 2 was supposed to be released in 2023!

We originally planned to release Season 2 in 2023, about a year after Season 1. This delay happened because we moved our production to Blender.

Originally, FreshWomen was made in Daz 3D, a very beginner-friendly 3D software, that served us very well for Season 1. Problem is, we hit a quality ceiling in Daz, and there wasn't any space to grow with it. There are A LOT of features missing in Daz, specially in animations.

For example, I animated most of Season 1, and it was entirely animated on Daz. Daz doesn't loop animations natively. If you try to do it with the tools available there, they'll come out choppy (as it happens in a lot of other AVNs). You know what I'm talking about, those looped animations where the animation slows down and speeds up right where it should loop. Our animations have seamless loop because we figured out a way to circumvent these issues (with a bit of math and a clever workaround). This took us weeks to figure out.

In Blender, to loop an animation seamlessly, you just need to press Shift+E on your timeline.

And this is just a very basic animation problem. There were features missing in render, clothing, hair, animation, posing, rigging, materials, SSS, basically, everywhere we looked, we had technical issues that wouldn't exist in Blender, and prevented visual evolution.

That's why we decided to move our production to Blender as soon as Season 2 started. Problem is, we had to basically redo almost everything, and train everybody. We redid characters, rigs, textures, hair, clothing, scenery, backend systems (like our render farm), and got our team up to speed.

This took a lot of effort and time, and made releasing Season 2 in 2023 impossible, but, in my opinion, it paid off big time. Look at a few renders on Season 2 side by side with Season 1, and you'll notice a big difference. Alyssa's scene in the pool, on Season 2, Episode 2 is my personal favorite.

[h1]Why do we have so many reviews? And why so many of them are from Asian countries?[/h1]

This is actually a very good question, that doesn't get asked too often!

Originally, we were going to release Season 1 in English. But, a few weeks prior to release, Oppaiman made translations possible, and we translated FreshWomen to 14 different languages.

We thought these translations would increase sales a bit, but didn't expect it would have a huge impact. We were 100% wrong. Turns out, people love playing games in their native language, and China turned out to be our second or third-largest player base.

[h1]How much do we charge devs to publish their games at Oppaiman Store?[/h1]

Nothing.

As of now, all payments are processed through Patreon, and go straight to devs. 

In the future, we’ll implement new payment methods, so devs can reach markets that Patreon doesn’t support, and one time payments are available. Then, we’ll charge devs a 15% fee for this service and for the infrastructure we provide (store page, storage, fast download, marketing, etc). For comparison, other stores usually charge indie devs 30%.

That’s it for this week, guys!

Thank you for being with us, and for believing in our games!

If you have any more questions, feel free to ask them in the comments!

See you soon, 

f1r3

notes.title: A great launch, Forbidden Fantasy CH3 and FreshWomen Season 2 Episode 3 Part 2
notes.content:
[url=http://oppai.me/chdv][img]https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/6846890_14-06-2024-09-37-24-059_StatusUpdate1406.png[/img][/url]
Hello, my dear FreshMen!

What an exciting week we had! 

Our release of FreshWomen Season 2 Episode 3 Part 1 was a huge success, with more than 3000 copies downloaded in the first week and 94% positive reviews! 

[b]Check it out: [url=http://oppai.me/s2e3p1_check_it]http://oppai.me/s2e3p1_check_it[/url][/b]

This was an amazing reception, and our team is ecstatic about it! Your feedbacks were spot on, and got us back in the right path. Thank you for your honesty and support! 

I want to take this feedback loop to the next level: if you’d like to give feedbacks about FreshWomen and Forbidden Fantasy straight to the devs, e-mail me at lucas@oppaiman.com . I’ll read all of your feedbacks, and relay them to our team!

In other news, we’re already working on Season 2 Episode 3 Part 2, and man, have we hit the ground running. We’re already done with the blocking stage! A few corrections and improvements are necessary here and there, but our team is already on it. Next week we’ll move all scenes to lighting and facial expressions!

Our animation pipeline is finally clicking with Mocap, and our animator is working miracles! We’ve made a few changes in how we deal with different processes, and today we finished blocking EVERY animation that’ll be in the next release. They’ll go through a round of feedbacks next week, then go to the next stages: secondary movement, tertiary movement, hair and render. I believe that by the end of next week, we’ll send our first animations to final render and sound design!

I’m very happy with this production speed! Our team has improved a lot over the last few months, and I can’t wait to see where we’ll be in the near future.

Here’s a quick summary of our progress on Season 2 Episode 3 Part 2:
[list]
[*][b] Blocking:[/b] DONE, but a few corrections are necessary;
[*][b] Lighting:[/b] 0 scenes done, 8 to go;
[*] [b]Facial Expression: [/b]0 scenes done, 8 to go!;
[*] [b]Cloth Simulation and Polish:[/b] 0 scenes done, 8 to go;
[*][b] Animations:[/b] 27 animations blocked, going to review and then next stages;
[*] [b]Characters, Script and Storyboards are done![/b]
[*] [b]Voice Acting is done![/b]
[/list]

We made a few improvements to our skin shaders, so you’ll see a quality bump in the next part. We’ll also debut the cloth simulation system I mentioned a few weeks ago, and a hair simulation system that showed A LOT of potential. If we get these tech improvements to work as expected, our release times will be even better!

By the way, Forbidden Fantasy Chapter 3 is entering its final stretch, and we’ll announce a release date for it soon! 

I’m honestly amazed at the work the Forbidden Fantasy team is doing, and I’m sure you’ll be too. Chapter 3 has very impressive visuals, great animations and a surprising story. 

Here’s our progress on Forbidden Fantasy Chapter 3 so far:
[list]
[*][b] Blocking:[/b] DONE!;
[*][b] Lighting: [/b]DONE!;
[*] [b]Facial Expression:[/b] DONE!;
[*] [b]Cloth Simulation and Polish:[/b] 4 scenes done, 5 in progress, 0 to go;
[*] [b]Animations:[/b] 20 done, 8 in progress, 0 to go;
[*] [b]Characters, Script and Storyboards are done![/b]
[*] [b]Voice Acting is done![/b]
[/list]

Wheeew! What a lovely week! 

I sometimes look back at how things were when we started, and it is incredible how things have changed. With a lot of hard work, and a lot of support from you, we managed to turn an idea into mesmerizing order, constant improvement and productivity. When I play our games, I get emotional because I feel that it was worth it!

Thank you for being with us in this adventure! Thank you for your patience, feedbacks and support. We’re building something truly special together! Great things are coming!

See you soon,

f1r3

notes.title: FREE VOICE UPDATE is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42153694/313260aa9ed0fcd25922799aa3e3cdc702ab9ff9.jpg[/img]


[h1]Voice Update is here! It’s finally time!
[/h1]

We are very excited to bring you this early Christmas gift. The Voice Update is a Major Update that brings FreshWomen Season 1 to a brand-new level.

It's a whole new immersive experience, where we put you right in the middle of the action!

Feel the vibration, the sounds, and the sensuality of each moment.

 
[h3]This Major Update includes:[/h3]

· Voice Acting for Episodes 1–5
· More than 5,600 voice lines.
· Intense moaning sounds
· Background noise, interaction sounds, breathing and more.
· Added Japanese, Korean and Czech translation
· Improved game support for 720p and low-end computers


This update will be applied automatically to the Steam Version, so all you have to do is download FreshWomen Season 1 on Steam and make sure it’s updated.

This gift we're sharing with you is our way of thanking you guys for all your love and support this year. It's also the result of the hard work of the entire Oppai-Man team, especially the talented voice actors and sound designers, who managed to make Season 1 even better.

We really hope you enjoy it.

 
Oppai-Man Team

notes.title: FREE DLC, S2 Ep. 2 Part 2 and Season 2 Steam Page - December is gonna be AWESOME
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42153694/77a52c52a46cc0f4845f7af85ac7e2cdf85c7c9a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]2023 is coming to an end, and we have lots of great news to share with you![/b][/h1]

December will be absolutely PACKED with launches, updates and GIFTS for you, who have been with us throughout this journey.

[h2][b][FREE DLC] - Season 1 - Moaning Update[/b][/h2]

Put your headphones on and turn up the volume, because come early December, all the girls you already love will have sexy voices and moans to make your gaming experience even better. 

The Moaning Update is coming for Season 1, and it will be TOTALLY FREE! That’s right! Everyone who bought the game on Steam or on our page will get our new DLC for free!

This DLC will add Voice Acting, Sexy Sounds and lots, lots of moaning to EVERY SCENE on Season 1!

Over the past year we’ve been working with very talented voice actresses and sound designers to bring Season 1 to a whole new level, and now we want to share it with you, as a way to thank you for all your love and support, and as an early Christmas gift!

So get ready, because Christmas is coming early this year, boys!


[h2][b]S2, ep.2 - part 2 on Beta
[/b][/h2]
Season 2 Episode 2 Part 2 is ready and being tested by our most loyal fans, just 2 months after the release of Part 1. This part develops the plot started in Part 1, and has a KILLER sexy scene with Alyssa in the pool! Honestly, it’s one of the prettiest scenes we’ve made ever!

Our goal is to bring you high quality content more frequently, and we’re striving to do that!

[b]Part 2 is a banger, and we hope you love it as much as we do![/b]



[h2][b]Season 2 page on Steam[/b][/h2]

Season 2 is almost halfway through, and we're preparing for its release on Steam. 

Although the full release on Steam is still a few months in the future, we're going to launch the Steam page in December to start collecting Wishlists.

Wishlists are a key metric on Steam, as they will make our game visible to more people when it launches. They’ll also notify you when we release the full game, so you can get it as soon as it’s available. 

If you want to buy Season 2 on Steam, or want to support us even further, please wishlist Season 2 on Steam!

As soon as it's available, we'll e-mail you. Then, all you have to do is add Season 2 to your wishlist and share it with your friends and anyone else you think might like it. 

Steam releases are VERY important, so if you can support us there, please do! We’re counting on you!

[b]Whew! That’s a lot of exciting news!
[/b]
We’ve been planing this releases for quite some time now, and our hearts are overflowing with joy that it’s finally time to share it with you!

[b]If you want to be one of the first ones to receive release dates, go to [url=http://oppai.me/steam_3]freshwomen.net[/url] and sign up.[/b]


We’re very excited for this releases, and we hope you are too. Thank you so much for your love and support!

December will be AWESOME!

OppaiMan Team
